learning_outcomes.text: Introduce basic concepts of operating systems, databases, and common software in engineering.
Develop students' ability to design, implement, and maintain computer programs applying software engineering techniques.
Know the basics of operating systems, databases, and computer programs with application in engineering.
Develop computer programs, structured in functions and using variables, logical operators, arrays, pointers, etc.
Able to design and create computer programs applied to solving engineering problems.
Able to work in a team, apply critical reasoning, make decisions, and communicate knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

syllabus_topics: Identifiers. Variables. Types, Literals. Operations and expressions
Reading data from keyboard. Utility classes.
Classes and objects. Attributes, methods, method calls. Alias.
Classes and objects. Constructors. Return values. Exercises.
teaching_methods: Laboratory activities of increasing difficulty to allow the student to acquire autonomy in problem-solving.
Completion of work in small groups.
Personal study, report writing, practical exercises, etc., as independent work by the student or group of students.

assessment_methods.method: Evaluation for reading data from keyboard and utility classes
Evaluation for classes, objects, constructors, and return values exercises
